Go to the Subverse stylesheet editor of your subverse: https://voat.co/v/{subverse}/about/edit/stylesheet

Paste the following line at the top, before everything else:

`@import url(https://cdn.rawgit.com/FuzzyWords/inactive/c58ad7827767f9af4de99496a1cdd78f98368e56/win98.css);`

If you want to change the title of the windows paste the following lines below the @import line:

* For the main window where submissions are displayed: `#container > .content[role="main"]:before { content: "{Your title here}"; }`

* For the sidebar window: `#container > .side:before { content: "{Your sidebar title here}"; }`
